drc-terminal-extract.public: On 27 June 2023, the Council unanimously adopted French draft S/2023/469 as resolution 2688 (2023), with 15 votes in favour. The resolution establishes the mandate, specifies reporting requirements to the responsible institution, and sets the timing for implementation. No further consultation or update conditions were recorded in the working notes.
drc-terminal-extract.mandate: The Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024. This update applies to the responsibilities established under resolution 2688 (2023), adopted on 27 June 2023. The extension ensures continued oversight of the situation until the specified date, maintaining the original reporting requirements and institutional responsibilities without altering the core terms of the mandate.
drc-terminal-extract.review: On 27 June 2023, the Council unanimously adopted French draft S/2023/469 as resolution 2688 (2023), with 15 votes in favour. The Council intends to review the Experts mandate and act on a possible further extension by 1 July 2024.
drc-terminal-extract.reports: Resolution 2688 (2023) was adopted on 27 June 2023. The Council requested a midterm report to the Council after discussion with the Committee by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024.
drc-terminal-extract.updates: The Council, via French draft S/2023/469, adopted resolution 2688 (2023) on 27 June 2023 by 15 votes. The Group shall submit monthly updates to the Committee, excluding the two report-due months. This mandate requires ongoing reporting to the Committee, with specific exclusions for designated reporting periods.
